name: Write the editor's host surface from the Nox host
body: The C++ build rewrote `apps/world-editor/src/ui/editor-host-surface.json` after every build. Regenerate it with `./build/lantern-world-editor --host-surface ../src/ui/editor-host-surface.json` instead, and say so in the README. It loses the 21 rows only C++ Penumbra wrote (`PenumbraWidget`, `WidgetRef` and their methods), which nothing in `src/ui` uses.

comments.text: Done in the M5 PR; stays in-progress until it merges.
